# Cloud Web static target fixture

Exact copy of `apps/cloud/contracts/web0.1/web-static-bundle-target.acl` at
Cloud revision `2ff9eedb8a245d42e57b386849a10c5c2d815420`.

The fixture is retained in Gateway so its hermetic tests do not require a
private Cloud checkout. It is generated by the Cloud-owned
`render_web_static_bundle_target_acl_blocks` contract. Do not hand-convert
digests or remove delivery policy to make Gateway accept it. The full WEB0
joint gate must compare the pinned Cloud render against this fixture.
